content.title: Trionfi Cycle - Allegorical Triumph Drawings
content.description: Complete illustrated Trionfi cycle with labeled historical figures. NOT Triumph of Death as catalogs suggest - includes Triumph of Fame/Mars, Triumph of Avarice, Triumph of Learning.

findings.description: Catalog says Triumph of Death - actually multiple triumphs (Fame, Avarice, Learning)
Named historical figures: Alexander, Caesar, Hannibal, Aristotle, Ptolemy, etc.

discovery.initial_interest: Fell through 3 cataloging projects, question marks in description
